card.name: Trial and error until something works
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about trying options or adjusting a dose until the right one is found, such as 'experimenting', 'until', 'before', 'find' and 'try'. They appear just before 'you find the one that works best' or 'an adequate response is achieved'.

modes.label: Trying products or options
modes.description: Advice that a person may need to try several products before finding one that suits them.
modes.example: There are so many products out there that it may take some<< experimenting>> before you find the one that works best

modes.label: Stepwise dose adjustment
modes.description: Dosing text about raising or lowering a dose until a response is reached.
modes.example: preferably at intervals of not less than 2 days,<< until>> an adequate response is achieved.

card.writes: It pushes words about experimenting, searching and finding what works.
card.plain: It marks sentences saying you may have to try a few things before finding what works.
